clue.text: One holding to line from the gospel translated by Catholic

indicators.note: translated means the words the gospel are rendered into a different form, their letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A passage from the gospel rendered into another language by a Catholic scholar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Line' looks religious in a gospel setting, but it is a washing line.
explanation.definitionFit: A peg grips laundry, keeping it fastened to the washing line while it dries.

clue.text: Nervy old hosts backing mime artist

indicators.note: hosts means the word for old contains another piece, as a host holds guests

parts.note: old means aged

indicators.note: backing means the name of the mime artist is read backwards

parts.note: Jacques Tati was a French mime artist and film-maker

explanation.surface: Elderly people nervously hosting a performance by a mime.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone nervy is jumpy and on edge, the same state as being flustered or worked up.

clue.text: Wind cutting through walker's wet-weather gear

indicators.note: cutting means one piece slices into the middle of the other

parts.note: through, as in 'by way of', means by
to wind something is to roll it up

explanation.surface: A gust of wind penetrating a hiker's waterproofs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wind' reads as weather, but it is the verb to roll up.
explanation.definitionFit: A brolly is British slang for an umbrella, carried by a walker against rain.

clue.text: Unopened perfume's grim

indicators.note: unopened means the word for perfume loses its first letter, its opening

parts.note: a perfume is a scent or odour

explanation.surface: A bottle of scent still sealed is a gloomy prospect.
explanation.definitionFit: Dour describes a stern, gloomy, unsmiling manner, the same as grim.

clue.text: Cabinet needs this condition placed on shipping

indicators.note: in a down clue, placed on means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: a condition is a state
craft means boats or vessels collectively, i.e. shipping

explanation.surface: Ministers must impose some requirement on the shipping industry.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a description: a government cabinet needs skill in governing.
explanation.definitionFit: The art of conducting government affairs is what any cabinet of ministers requires.

clue.text: Happy couple in Rome crossing banks of oriental flowers

parts.note: happy means glad

indicators.note: crossing means the Roman two straddles the other letters, which sit between its I's

parts.note: II is two in Roman numerals

indicators.note: banks of means the outer letters, the edges of the word oriental

explanation.surface: A happy pair in Rome crossing the riverbanks among eastern blooms.
explanation.definitionFit: Gladioli are tall garden plants with sword-shaped leaves and spikes of showy blossoms.

clue.text: Old-fashioned mum carrying nine spinning tops

indicators.note: carrying means the word for mum holds another piece inside

parts.note: mama is a dated word for mother

indicators.note: spinning means the Roman numeral for nine is turned round

parts.note: IX is nine in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A traditional mother holding nine spinning tops, the toys.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tops' looks like toys beside 'spinning', but it means peaks: the plural of maximum.
explanation.definitionFit: Maxima are highest points or upper limits, plural of maximum, so peaks or highs.

clue.text: One particular therapy primarily for a man

indicators.note: primarily means the first letter of the word therapy

parts.note: his means belonging to a man

explanation.surface: A specific treatment designed mainly for men.
explanation.definitionFit: This picks out a specific single item, as in 'this one', a particular thing.

clue.text: Drunken rowdy lecturer dismissed on sovereign's return

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means the following pieces come after it
return means the word for royal is read backwards

parts.note: sovereign's, belonging to a monarch, means regal
in cricket a dismissed batsman is out

explanation.surface: A tutor sacked after the monarch comes back.
explanation.definitionFit: A lager lout is a British term for a young man made aggressive by too much beer.

clue.text: Secure saddle as horse shelters

indicators.note: shelters means the phrase saddle as horse holds the letters within it

explanation.surface: Fasten the saddle while the horse takes cover.
explanation.definitionFit: To leash an animal is to tether it, keeping it held fast on a lead.

clue.text: Official brutality exposed and condemned

indicators.note: condemned means the remaining letters are wrecked and rearranged
exposed means the word brutality is stripped of its outer letters, its covering

explanation.surface: Brutality is revealed and denounced.
explanation.definitionFit: Titular means held by virtue of a title, nominally official rather than real.

clue.text: Drinks rum during matches

indicators.note: during means the word for rum sits inside the other piece

parts.note: ties are matches or fixtures in a cup competition
rum, in British slang, means odd or strange

explanation.surface: Spirits consumed while the games are being played.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rum' looks like the drink, but here it means strange.
explanation.definitionFit: Toddies are hot alcoholic drinks of spirit, sugar and water, so a kind of drink.

clue.text: Record number of competitors

definitions.meaning: an item written in a register or log
the total field signed up for a race or contest

explanation.surface: A record turnout of contestants.
explanation.definitionFit: An entry is an item logged in a register, and also the field of runners in a race.

clue.text: Unsympathetic type, one committed to very firm course

parts.note: very means so, as in 'so good'

indicators.note: committed to means one piece is sent into another, as to an institution

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
I is the Roman numeral one
a course or route is a path

explanation.surface: A person devoted to a very solid plan of action.
explanation.definitionFit: A sociopath lacks empathy or conscience, so is a cold, unfeeling sort of person.

clue.text: Two gymnastic manoeuvres to complete course in Beijing?

indicators.note: to complete means the second move is added to finish the first

parts.note: the two gymnastic manoeuvres supply two moves, the first a spring or leap
the second manoeuvre is a roll, as in a forward roll

explanation.surface: A gymnast needs a pair of moves to finish a routine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Course' suggests a gymnastics circuit, but it is a course of a meal; the question mark flags a Chinese dish.
explanation.definitionFit: A spring roll is a crisp pancake-wrapped Chinese starter, a course in a Beijing meal.

clue.text: Spooner's to stay and work in garden extensively

indicators.note: Spooner's means the opening sounds of two words are swapped, after Rev Spooner

parts.note: to lie is to stay or remain somewhere
to hoe is to weed or work the soil in a garden

explanation.surface: A man staying on to toil in his garden.
explanation.walkthrough: Swapping the opening sounds of 'lie' and 'hoe' gives 'high' and 'low'; 'and' stays where it is.
explanation.definitionFit: To search high and low is to look everywhere, thoroughly and over a wide area.

clue.text: Keeping any driver from parking bum in ringside seat

parts.note: P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

indicators.note: bum, as an adjective meaning poor or wrong, means the letters of in ringside seat are jumbled

explanation.surface: Keeping drivers away by parking yourself in a ringside seat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bum' looks like the noun for a backside sitting in a seat, but it is the adjective bad.
explanation.definitionFit: Pedestrianising a street means closing it to traffic so motorists cannot use it.

clue.text: Guard dispatched before brief communist uprising

indicators.note: before means the first piece comes ahead of the next

parts.note: dispatched means sent

indicators.note: in a down clue, uprising means the shortened name is read upwards
brief means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: Lenin was the Russian communist revolutionary leader

explanation.surface: A guard was sent ahead of a short-lived communist revolt.
explanation.definitionFit: A sentinel is a soldier or watchman posted to keep watch, a lookout.

clue.text: Immature island cattle ultimately eating tall grass

indicators.note: eating means the island piece takes another inside it

parts.note: inch is a Scottish word for a small island

indicators.note: ultimately means the last letter of the word cattle

parts.note: the oat is a tall cereal grass

explanation.surface: Young cattle on an island grazing on long grass.
explanation.walkthrough: INCH, a Scots word for an islet, appears in names such as Inchcolm.
explanation.definitionFit: Inchoate means just begun and not fully formed, so undeveloped or rudimentary.

clue.text: Seed for cooking oil milled by devotee

indicators.note: by means the two pieces are placed next to each other

parts.note: milled grain is ground
a nut is an enthusiast or fan

explanation.surface: An enthusiast grinds seeds to make cooking oil.
explanation.definitionFit: The peanut, or groundnut, is pressed for an oil widely used for frying.

clue.text: Get the better of berk at Balliol?

parts.note: Balliol is a college of Oxford University, OU
berk is British slang for a fool or twit

explanation.surface: A fool studying at an Oxford college.
explanation.walkthrough: Balliol is one of the colleges of Oxford University.
explanation.definitionFit: To outwit someone is to beat them by being cleverer, to outsmart them.

clue.text: Drink children fed to bird that perished

indicators.note: fed to means one piece is put into the other

parts.note: the moa was a flightless bird of New Zealand, now extinct

explanation.surface: Kids gave a drink to a bird that then died.
explanation.definitionFit: Mocha is a coffee drink, often blended with chocolate.

clue.text: Soggy pitch with damage on top

indicators.note: in a down clue, on top means this piece sits above the other

parts.note: to mar is to damage
to shy is to throw or pitch

explanation.surface: A waterlogged sports pitch with a damaged surface.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pitch' looks like a sports field, but it is the verb to throw.
explanation.definitionFit: Marshy ground is boggy and waterlogged, so wet and squelching underfoot.

clue.text: After setback, leading bank's less stable

indicators.note: after a setback means the word for leading is turned back to front

parts.note: leading means top, as in the top team
a bank, as of seats or keys, is a tier

explanation.surface: Following a reversal, the leading bank is less secure.
explanation.definitionFit: Potty is British slang for crazy, so pottier is more unhinged and mentally less balanced.

clue.text: Drive husband to drink, being contrary

indicators.note: being contrary means the combined letters are turned the opposite way round

parts.note: to sup is to drink

explanation.surface: An awkward wife drives her husband to drink.
explanation.definitionFit: To drive someone forward is to push them, propelling or urging them on.

clue.text: Eg shogun's promise to surround area on both sides

indicators.note: to surround means the promise wraps around the other letters

parts.note: to give your word is to promise
both sides are right and left, R and L

explanation.surface: A Japanese ruler swore to encircle territory from both flanks.
explanation.definitionFit: A shogun was a hereditary Japanese military commander, an example of a military chief ruling by force.

clue.text: Defect from regiment at last, post-conflict

indicators.note: post means the next piece comes after the word for conflict

parts.note: a war is a conflict

indicators.note: at last means the final letter of the word regiment

explanation.surface: A soldier finally deserts his regiment once the war is over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Defect' looks like a verb, to desert, but it is the noun: a blemish.
explanation.definitionFit: A wart is a small growth on the skin, a blemish or flaw.

clue.text: Clip tail of aggressive bird

parts.note: to clip is to snip

indicators.note: tail of means the last letter of the word aggressive

explanation.surface: Trim the tail feathers of a fierce bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The snipe is a wading bird with a long straight bill, found in marshes.

clue.text: Such a movement with added energy could be altogether different

indicators.note: could be altogether different means the letters of altogether can be rearranged into the answer plus energy

parts.note: E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: Add more energy and the movement would be quite another thing.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer plus E, with its letters rearranged, makes ALTOGETHER.
explanation.definitionFit: A larghetto is a musical piece or section played fairly slowly, a slower sort of movement.
